enable_lie_group_check_context: create a context manager to enable Lie group checks within a scoped block of code
disable_lie_group_check_context: create a context manager to disable Lie group checks within a scoped block of code
set_lie_group_check_enabled_mode: create a context manager to set Lie group check mode to enabled or disabled with optional silence flags
silence_internal_warnings_context: create a context manager to silence internal warnings during Lie group check operations
get_lie_group_check_context: review the _LieGroupCheckContext class to get current thread-local Lie group check settings
